Evidence from the live page's own build, 2026-11-20, team project dropped on the built-in robot: Meet0 MAIN TeleOp with the left stick forward for 2 s moved 0.9 in forward, 2.4 in sideways and turned 114 degrees (the built-in robot's wheel mounting is measured from its CAD as -1 -1 +1 +1; the team's code is written for a robot where all four are reversed); intake is bound to the lift and outtake1/outtake2 to the arm; Meet0 Auto RED does not move at all (the line reader took it as fully read with 0 statements); Meet0 Auto BLUE turns 21 degrees and moves 4.7 in. The headless check of the same code on a plain robot passes 19 of 19 (with the auto-drive fix). So the team's code is right and the page gives it the wrong robot: this item is what makes the page usable for a team with code and no CAD. Moved up to run right after the auto-drive fix.
